_about: Higgsfield art for Frontier Command. Model gpt_image_2_5, quality medium, 1k, 16:9. Every prompt ends with the shared style line. Entries with a url were generated and can be downloaded with tools/fetch-art.py. Entries without one still need generating.
style: Cinematic science-fiction television VFX still, photoreal, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

images.prompt: A lush Earth-like class M planet seen from high orbit: deep blue oceans, green and brown continents, swirling white cloud systems, thin glowing blue atmosphere rim, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

A desert planet seen from high orbit: ochre and rust sand seas, dry canyons and salt flats, thin dusty tan haze at the limb, harsh sunlight, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

A frozen glaciated ice planet seen from high orbit: white and pale cyan ice sheets, long blue fracture lines, frozen seas, faint pale atmosphere, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.
A huge banded gas giant seen from orbit with thin tilted rings and two small moons: cream, amber and rust storm bands, a giant oval storm, the planet fills most of the frame, deep black starfield.

A hellish toxic planet seen from orbit: thick sickly yellow-green corrosive cloud layers, flashes of lightning inside the clouds, murky sulphurous haze at the limb, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

A volcanic lava planet seen from orbit: black basalt crust cracked by glowing orange lava rivers and erupting volcanoes, dark ash plumes, red glow at the limb, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

A global ocean planet seen from orbit: deep sapphire water with scattered chains of tiny green islands, a spiral hurricane, bright specular sun glint, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

A barren airless rocky planet seen from orbit: grey-brown heavily cratered surface, long shadows, rilles and mountain ranges, no atmosphere, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

A dense jungle planet seen from orbit: continents covered in dark emerald rainforest, winding rivers, humid white cloud banks, faint violet-tinted atmosphere glow, the planet fills the right two-thirds of the frame, deep black starfield.

The forward view from a starship travelling at warp speed: countless stars stretched into long streaks of white and blue light rushing toward the viewer from a central vanishing point, faint blue tunnel glow, deep black space. No ship visible.
A vast colourful emission nebula in deep space: billowing clouds of violet, magenta and orange gas, dark dust lanes, clusters of bright young blue stars glowing inside.
A violent ion storm in deep space: churning walls of blue-violet plasma, crackling electrical filaments and lightning discharges arcing between clouds, ominous and dangerous.

A spatial anomaly: a jagged tear in the fabric of space-time, a glowing rift of white, magenta and electric blue light, the background starfield visibly warped and smeared around it, eerie and unnatural.
A stable wormhole opening in deep space: a swirling funnel of blue-white and gold light spiralling into a bright centre, gravitational lensing bending the surrounding stars.
A dense asteroid field in space: dozens of tumbling irregular grey and brown rocks of many sizes, some glinting with metallic ore, lit from the side by a distant orange star, dust haze.

An ancient derelict alien starship drifting dark and silent in space: a long ribbed hull of unfamiliar design, large breaches in the hull, a few flickering dim emergency lights, a cloud of small debris around it, lit faintly by a distant star.

A huge orbital starbase space station above a blue planet: a large domed upper section on a long central spire with ring-shaped docking levels, clean white-grey hull plating, hundreds of lit windows, glowing docking bay doors, small shuttle lights nearby. Original design. No insignia.

A gaudy independent trading outpost space station: ramshackle clusters of mismatched modules, bright orange and gold advertising lights, cargo containers stacked on the hull, several small freighters docked, set against a dusty nebula. No readable text.

A rapidly spinning pulsar neutron star in space: a tiny brilliant blue-white core emitting two narrow opposing beams of intense radiation, glowing magnetic field loops around it, surrounding faint nebula.

A colossal ancient alien megastructure encircling a star: a partially built shell of enormous dark hexagonal panels, gaps glowing with trapped starlight, clearly millions of years old, a tiny starship silhouette for scale.
A vast living crystalline energy entity drifting through space: a huge lattice of glowing geometric crystal spikes, radiating prismatic rainbow light and soft white glow, beautiful and dangerous.
A black hole in deep space: a pitch-black event horizon surrounded by a blazing orange and white accretion disk, strong gravitational lensing bending the disk and stars into arcs.

An elegant exploration starship cruising above a blue and white planet: a large flat disc-shaped primary hull joined by a slim angled neck to a smaller cylindrical secondary hull, two long warp engine nacelles on swept-back pylons glowing blue, white-grey hull with fine panel lines and rows of lit windows, dramatic rim light. Original design. No registry numbers or insignia.
images.note: Title image supplied by the user (made with Gemini): an Intrepid, a Galaxy and a Defiant in formation. 21:9.
